channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: The Air Force 1 Is in Bloom This Spring
item.description: The Nike Air Force 1 ‘Flower Pack’ features two new designs, one in the style of the rose, and the other as cherry blossom often referred to as Sakura.

item.title: Converse’s Cute Ballet Shoes Have Serious Sole
item.description: Ballet sneakers are everywhere right now, but the Converse All Star Trek Wave BL OX “Gingham Pack” is an outlier by design.

item.title: These Beautiful Vans Are a Not-So-Hidden Gem
item.description: Vans is on a tear at the moment, and the latest head-turner is the Vans Old Skool Gemstone Pack.

item.title: Dave Is the First Musician to Ever Rep Custom Stone Island (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Dave's insane Stone Island collection just improved as he's the only musician to ever design a custom Stone Island collection.

item.title: Nike’s Pretty Pastel Air Forces Are Pure Easter Egg-cellence
item.description: Nike debuts a patent pastel-colored Air Force 1 Low "Easter" sneaker for 2026, playing on the classic design from the early 2000s.

item.title: Jumpman’s Greatest Sneaker Looks Prettiest in H(Air) Jordan Barrettes
item.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG "Psychic Blue" releases as a fun & textural spin featuring branded barrette hair clips.

item.title: In Black Mesh, Nike’s Techy Air Max Shows off Its Summer Body
item.description: Nike's Air Max DN8 "Black Mesh" sneaker doubles down on the breathable material for a seriously summer-ready take.

item.title: Converse’s Leather Dress Sneaker Is Plain (Toe) & Simple
item.description: Converse's All Star Coupe Plain Toe OX is an even more refined version of the classic dressy sneaker, literal plain toes included.

item.title: adidas' Flattest Mary Jane Sneaker Fell Straight from the Clear Blue Skies
item.description: adidas' Tokyo MJ "Crystal Sky" lands as a pale blue version of the Mary Jane-style sneaker.
